name: RideKC Micro Transit (Johnson County)
note: Approximately 80-square-mile microtransit zone covering Downtown Overland Park, Mission Transit Center, and KU Edwards Campus; radius_km = sqrt(80*2.59/pi) = 8.12, clipped to Johnson County. Source: https://www.jocogov.org/department/transit-ridekc-johnson-county/micro-transit

name: RideKC On-Demand (Wyandotte County / IRIS)

name: RideLV Micro Transit
note: Primarily Leavenworth city limits with extensions to four addresses in Lansing, KS (Progress Drive; W. Eisenhower Rd/DaVita Dialysis; First Terrace)
